regime: Risk-On Relief Rally, NQ ES and Gold Reclaim Their Stops
summary: The market bought yesterday's Fed dip. One day after the hawkish read sold everything, the tape reversed and went risk-on. NQ rose 1.54 percent to 29,419, ES gained 1.11 percent to 7,638, and December gold added 1.82 percent to 4,380, and all three reclaimed the trend stops they lost yesterday. Crude was the lone holdout, down another 0.91 percent to 101.09 and still under its stop. VIX fell about 13 percent to 15.44, back to a calm level. The catch: NQ ran to 29,498, then gave back the last two hours into the close, a small tell that buyers eased off ahead of tomorrow's quad witching.

event.name: Day after FOMC (weekly jobless claims 8:30 am ET); quad witching Friday Sep 18
event.consensus: Yesterday's FOMC read hawkish and sold stocks, gold, and crude
event.actual: Today the market faded that reaction with a broad relief rally. Weekly initial jobless claims printed at 8:30 am ET and the tape shrugged it off and rallied.
event.surprise: Risk-on reversal. NQ, ES, and December gold all reclaimed the trend stops they lost yesterday; crude was the lone laggard and stayed below its stop.
event.nqReaction: NQ was back above its stop overnight, broke up out of a wide 129 point opening range, ran to 29,498 just shy of 29,500, then eased the last two hours to close 29,419, still above its stop.
event.crossAsset: ES +1.11 percent to 7,638 and December gold +1.82 percent to 4,380, both back above their stops. October gold (MGC1!) closed 4,346.5. Crude fell 0.91 percent to 101.09, still below its stop. VIX down about 13 percent to 15.44. Tomorrow, Friday Sep 18, is quarterly quad witching, about 6.2 trillion dollars of options exposure expiring, on the final day of the BOJ meeting.

risk.sizing: The acute event risk is behind us. Three of four markets reclaimed their trend stops on a clean up day and VIX fell to 15.44. But this was a one-day reversal of a violent event, so trend conviction is still building, and tomorrow is a quad witching Friday that can whip the open on mechanical flow. Keep size measured into the expiry and do not chase the open.
risk.openRisk: The stops are the line. NQ is above 29,251, ES above 7,611, and December gold above 4,353, so all three carry a with-trend long lean while they hold. Crude is below 102.20, a with-trend short lean until it reclaims that stop on two hourly closes. Upside references are today's highs and the round numbers above: NQ 29,500 then 29,600, ES 7,700, gold 4,421 then 4,450. Downside references if the stops give way are today's lows: NQ 29,343, ES 7,551 overnight, gold 4,300 psych, and for crude the 100.25 RTH low, 99.10 overnight low, and the 99 round.
risk.note: Friday, September 18 is quarterly quad witching on the final day of the BOJ meeting, so expect heavy, mechanical volume and an open that can whip on positioning rather than direction. Keep size small into the expiry and let the levels confirm. Not financial advice.

psychology: Yesterday whipped. Today reversed the whip. If you shorted the Fed close and held it, today hurt, and if you flipped long at the open you rode a clean trend. Here is the lesson both traders should take: two big opposite days in a row is not a trend, it is a market finding its footing. The pros did not marry yesterday's hawkish story or today's relief story. They traded the levels in front of them and let the stops do the deciding. Notice NQ faded off its highs into the close. That is normal profit taking before a quad witching Friday, not a new signal. Keep your size honest into an expiry day, because the flow gets mechanical and the moves can be noise dressed up as conviction.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html: NQ opened into a wide 129 point range: high 29,437.75, low 29,308.75. Price broke up out of that range and confirmed the break at 15:30 UTC, then ran to 29,498.75, one tick from the 29,500 psych. Into the close it faded the last two hours back inside the range to 29,419, closing a touch below NYVWAP 29,426. So the breakout ran but did not hold its highs, which reads as profit taking ahead of the expiry rather than a failure. For Friday all four HTA OPEN plays are eligible by calendar: BIR, HOF, MID, and BNC. Just remember quad witching can distort the open. Conditional and educational only.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long is back on the board. The regime filter re-armed today because both indices closed above their trend stops, after being off yesterday. Today did give an upside break, but it faded back inside the range into the close, so a fresh momentum long is possible yet soft. The clean version is a hold above the opening range high and the 29,500 wall on two hourly closes. Quad witching tomorrow can distort the open, so let the break prove itself before sizing in.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,430, close 29,419 sits about 0.6 sigma below the mean. Bands: plus 2 sigma 29,468, plus 3 sigma 29,487, minus 2 sigma 29,392, minus 3 sigma 29,373. Sigma compressed to about 19 today, the mirror of yesterday's blown out 113. The RTH high 29,498 tagged just past the plus 3 sigma band and faded about 80 points, but on a tight trend day a 3 sigma tag is only a small absolute stretch, so it is not a strong fade signal. Volume is unavailable on the continuous contract, so this is price only. Wait for the range to widen before trusting a fresh fade.
